title: Student Engagement in Technology-Mediated Hybrid Higher Education: An Exploratory Institutional Case Study - Dataset and Reproduction Code
description: Anonymised questionnaire dataset and fully commented Python code supporting the article 'Student Engagement in Technology-Mediated Hybrid Higher Education: An Exploratory Institutional Case Study'. The release reproduces the composite-index reliability analyses, descriptive statistics, Spearman correlations with bootstrap confidence intervals, item-level analyses, gender comparisons using Mann-Whitney tests and Cliff's delta, robust regression models, programme-adjusted sensitivity analyses, exploratory clustering with and without weekly study hours, and scripted lexical analysis of open-ended responses.
